findings.claim: 候选仅三条已审计任务总控GET目录参数换ReadCatalogDependency，全部原函数体、其他函数与POST保持。读取准入不构成运行授权，反馈Receipt/unknown校验保留。
findings.evidence: .evidence/qyh-cockpit-read-dependencies-20261013/router-diff-material.txt 显示仅 get_ecommerce_workshop_task_cockpit_feedback / get_ecommerce_workshop_task_cockpit_dispatch_scenario / get_ecommerce_workshop_task_cockpit_batch_scenario 三个 GET 路由的 catalog 参数由 CatalogDependency 换为 ReadCatalogDependency；.evidence/qyh-cockpit-read-dependencies-20261013/compatibility-material.txt 声明 allOtherOriginalAstEqual=true；plan-material.txt 声明 feedback/dispatch/batch 功能不变，仅换目录接入点。
